counts: Observed counts are exact retained training occurrences. pooled_ppm is a tuned source-mixture estimate, not a raw count. Subtitle mapping is an estimate; raw exact subtitle counts are separate.
admission: Existing ASCII lexicon plus words with >=50 train occurrences, >=10 document occurrences summed by source, >=2 sources or FineWeb >=100 occurrences across >=25 documents; no editorial modern probes.
